story.title: 一张从外婆厨房传下来的配方
paragraphs: 云惹坊的配方来自家里的娘惹长辈。小时候过年过节，厨房里总是蒸着一盘盘颜色鲜艳的糕点。
我们坚持用新鲜椰浆、真正的斑斓叶和蝶豆花上色，不走捷径，也不加多余的东西。
希望你吃到的每一块，都有那种被照顾的感觉。
story.quote: 娘惹糕不只是点心，是一家人围在一起的时光。

story.title: A recipe from grandma's kitchen
paragraphs: Our recipes come from the Nyonya elders in our family. Every festive season, the kitchen was filled with trays of colourful kuih.
We use fresh coconut milk and real pandan and butterfly pea for colour — no shortcuts, nothing extra.
We hope every piece feels like being looked after.
story.quote: Nyonya kuih isn't just a snack — it's time spent together as a family.

items.q: How long does the kuih keep?
items.a: Best on the day at room temperature; up to 2 days in the fridge — steam for 3–5 minutes to soften again.
Not if eaten the same day; otherwise keep it in the fridge.
We are not halal certified. All products are free from pork and lard.

items.q: Can I customise flavours or quantity?
